page_title: BRE 2-1 LYO | Brest v Lyon 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Jordan Amavi is substituted due to injury. Eric Roy gives a chance to Luc Zogbe (Brest).
90+3' Jordan Amavi (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Flag goes up against Abdallah Sima (Brest) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
88' Said Benrahma (Lyon) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
85' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Abdallah Sima (Brest) replaces Ludovic Ajorque.
84' Said Benrahma (Lyon) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
83' The resulting corner from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) comes to nothing.
80' Malick Fofana goes off the pitch and Said Benrahma (Lyon) comes on.

78' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest)'s poor effort is easily saved by Lucas Perri. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
76' Here comes a substitution. Alexandre Lacazette is given a rest as he is replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon).
76' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mama Balde and he is replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
76' Substitution. Kamory Doumbia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).

73' Mama Balde (Brest) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lucas Perri pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
72' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) inside the box.
72' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Clinton Mata (Lyon) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

68' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marco Bizot shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
67' Substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) in, Tanner Tessmann out.
66' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
66' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
64' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece.
62' Mama Balde (Brest) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Lucas Perri easily deals with the threat.
62' The corner from Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is intercepted by the defence.
61' Mahdi Camara (Brest) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
60' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul after Kamory Doumbia (Brest) hacks down one of his opponents.
57' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
57' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
56' The game is interrupted now, Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) for his blatant foul.
55' The goal by Brest is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
54' Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
53' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Mama Balde (Brest) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
52' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
52' A clumsy foul by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle.
50' Half-chance! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Marco Bizot reacts well to snuff out the attack.
47' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
47' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Jordan Veretout (Lyon) is replaced by Ernest Nuamah.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Massadio Haidara (Brest) is replaced by Jordan Amavi.
46' Pierre Sage has made a change at the break. Abner Vinicius (Lyon) has come on in place of Nicolas Tagliafico.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Mama Balde (Brest) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
45+6' Massadio Haidara (Brest) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+4' Massadio Haidara (Brest) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+4' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has a goal ruled out for offside!
45+2' 2 - 1 Goal Jordan Veretout (Lyon)! Jordan Veretout (Lyon) was put through by Malick Fofana and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
45+1' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Malick Fofana (Lyon) but poses no threat.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
43' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
40' A dangerous looking corner kick from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is cleared to safety by the defence.
39' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
37' The corner kick from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
37' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
34' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Perri intercepts the ball.
32' Total attempts – 4:3.
29' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
29' Clinton Mata (Lyon) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

28' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Marco Bizot guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Mahdi Camara provides Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
24' Dangerous play by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will take a corner kick.
22' Massadio Haidara (Brest) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
19' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
17' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will take the corner.
15' Lyon keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
13' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) prepares to take a corner kick.
11' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Mahdi Camara (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.

8' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Lucas Perri blocks the shot with his legs.
6' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
3' The match is interrupted due to poor visibility and looking at the pitch, we have to agree.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier was nominated as the referee for this game.
